name: hackernews-mcp
description: Hacker News (social): me, analytics_post. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

tools.name: me
tools.description: Unauthenticated read-only API: there is no account; the probe reads /v0/maxitem.json to confirm the API is reachable.

tools.name: analytics_post
tools.description: Item record: `score` and `descendants` (total comment count) are the only metrics HN publishes; the runtime cannot compose a nested `metrics` object, so they are top-level fields.
